caption: The drawing depicts a single clear, lidded glass jar with a slightly greenish tint. The jar consists of three main sections: a large bowl-shaped body, a round footed base, and a domed lid topped with a rounded finial. The surface of the jar has a smooth appearance with some subtle internal bubbles illustrated, and there are highlights and reflections to indicate its glass material. The background is a plain, light beige color. The jar is centered and occupies most of the space in the composition. There is a faint signature "JANET REZA" in the lower right corner.
title: Glass
